facts: The outer launcher process was terminated by the execution interface before it wrote accounting.json.
The child process remained alive because the runner created a separate session without a parent-death signal.
The child later wrote a syntactically complete 72-row medium output and exited, but the controller was absent during the tail of execution.
The orphan was explicitly terminated or confirmed gone before any subsequent case was admitted.
scientific_use: The generated observations are retained as failure evidence but excluded from manuscript tables, plots, claims, and accepted reproductions.
required_repair: Require the child to receive SIGKILL if the runner parent dies, retain a pre-launch reservation record, and rerun into a fresh output directory under an attached controller.
